question: How can an embodied and divided deity be invoked and act effectively?
premises: Meditation and worship take diverse forms.
An embodied and divided deity can be invoked.
Such invocation can produce effective action in an instant.
inference: The variety of meditation and worship is effective because an embodied, divided deity can be invoked and act immediately.
plain_english: Thus the variety of meditation, worship, and the like becomes effective in action: an embodied, divided deity, when invoked, can abandon its own enjoyments and act in an instant.
